signals.text: Cherki genius and Wharton excels -  Palace v Man City player ratings. How Crystal Palace and Manchester City's players rated following their Premier League match.
Arsenal & Barca monitor Rashford - Saturday's gossip. Arsenal monitor Marcus Rashford, Chelsea eye Monaco's Lamine Camara and Valencia push for Liverpool midfielder Harvey Elliott, plus more.

Ordonez's move to Palace in doubt after medical. Club Brugge defender Joel Ordonez's move to Crystal Palace runs into complications after his medical, with the Eagles set to decide whether to proceed with the deal.

Simeone would welcome Alvarez back to training amid Barca row. Diego Simeone says he will do everything he can to make Julian Alvarez feel important at Atletico Madrid, after confirming the Argentina international will miss Saturday’s match against Sevilla.
